name: Library building: 2 storey RCC frame on a 2 shatak plot

elements.Foundation: PCC blinding, 9 pad footings, column necks, plinth tie beams, sand fill
elements.Columns: 9 RCC columns x 2 storeys (3 x 3 grid, max span 3.6 m)
elements.Beams: floor and roof beams (450 mm deep) on every grid line
elements.Slabs: plinth slab, first floor slab with stair void, roof slab, entrance canopy
elements.Walls: 230/250 mm brick walls between columns, toilet partitions
elements.Openings: main glazed double door, rear exit door, toilet door, 16 windows with frames and glass
elements.Stair: dog-leg stair, 20 risers, 250 mm treads, glass balustrade at the void
elements.Interior: floor finishes, book stacks, wall shelves, issue desk, reading tables, carrels, chairs, toilet fittings
elements.Exterior: parapet with coping, LIBRARY sign, sunshades and sills, entrance steps and posts, roof tank
elements.Site: boundary wall, gate, pillars, paved front yard, tree, road

rules: footing stays inside the plot line
window area >= 10% of floor area on each floor
